tokens.name: concrete
tokens.usage: Identity. Pavement by day — the page surface in the Day theme.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Identity. A concrete slab — quiet panels by day (via `surface-concrete`).

tokens.name: asphalt
tokens.usage: Identity. Wet asphalt — ink by day, the page by night. Never pure black.

tokens.name: sign
tokens.usage: Identity. THE Sinho colour: the blue of a Korean road and station sign. The action fill by day (via `accent`), always with white text.

tokens.name: sign-lit
tokens.usage: Identity. The same sign, backlit at night — the action fill by night (via `accent`), with `asphalt` text.

tokens.name: centerline
tokens.usage: Identity. Road centre-line yellow — marks on dark ground (LaneRule by night, signboard accents, the button on a signboard). Never text on a light surface.

tokens.name: led
tokens.usage: Identity. The red-pink of an LED shop sign at night. Source of `neon`; never a large fill.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The page background everywhere. Pavement by day, asphalt by night.

tokens.name: surface-concrete
tokens.usage: Quiet panels: PaperCard, topic tags, code, Notice, the dashboard filter row, table hover.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Sign-blue tinted callouts: KeyFindings, the selected row. Use `ink`, `ink-secondary` or `link` on it — not `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: feed dividers, masthead edge, card borders, gridlines. 1px.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, the secondary button, the table header rule (≥3:1 on `surface` and `surface-concrete`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface (≥15:1).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Deks, labels, chart values — on all surfaces (≥7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata only (times, captions, axis ticks, route codes) on `surface` and `surface-concrete` (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action fill: primary Button, Switch on, selected segment, active underline. Sign blue with white text by day; lit sign with dark text by night.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on `accent` or `accent-hover` (≥6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, active nav and tab text, kickers, finding numerals — text-safe blue on all surfaces (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset (≥3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: marking
tokens.usage: Road marking: the LaneRule dashes, decorative icons, the infographic lane mark. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: neon
tokens.usage: The one warm light on the street — the editor's voice: the Insight label and the New tag only, one per screen (text-safe, ≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: neon-soft
tokens.usage: Reader highlights (`<mark>`) behind `ink`, and the New tag behind `neon` text.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: The signboard: IssueHero, SubscribeBox, Ticker, dark infographics. A black LED panel by day, a raised panel by night. Everything on it uses the `on-deep`/`deep-*` tokens.

tokens.name: deep-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim around signboard blocks (invisible by day, separates the block from the asphalt by night).

tokens.name: deep-lane
tokens.usage: Crosswalk and lane stripes drawn inside signboard blocks. Decoration, never text.

tokens.name: deep-flash
tokens.usage: The few yellow dashes on a signboard that catch the eye — one group per block.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Titles on `deep` (≥15:1).

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Body and metadata on `deep` (≥8.5:1).

tokens.name: deep-accent
tokens.usage: On `deep`: the kicker text and the button fill — centre-line yellow on black.

tokens.name: deep-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a `deep-accent` fill.

tokens.name: on-deep-accent
tokens.usage: Label on a `deep-accent` fill (≥11:1).

tokens.name: deep-field
tokens.usage: Email input background inside signboard blocks; `on-deep` text, `on-deep-muted` placeholder.

tokens.name: deep-field-line
tokens.usage: Input border inside signboard blocks (≥3:1 against `deep`).

tokens.name: deep-up
tokens.usage: Rises on a signboard (Ticker), international convention. Inside `[data-market="kr"]` rises use `deep-down`.

tokens.name: deep-down
tokens.usage: Falls on a signboard, international convention; rises under the Korean convention.

tokens.name: deep-cool
tokens.usage: Falls on a signboard under the Korean convention (`[data-market="kr"]`).

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Status: good / running / complete. Icon + word always. Text-safe on `surface` and `surface-concrete`.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Status: warning / delayed / provisional. Icon + word always. Text-safe on `surface` and `surface-concrete`.

tokens.name: status-serious
tokens.usage: Status: serious / degraded. Icon + word always. Text on `surface` only; use as an icon elsewhere.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Status: critical / error / suspended. Icon + word always. Text-safe on all surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors — an alias of `status-critical`, always with a sentence of text.

tokens.name: delta-good
tokens.usage: Delta text when the change is good for the reader. Always with sign and arrow.

tokens.name: delta-bad
tokens.usage: Delta text when the change is bad for the reader. Always with sign and arrow.

tokens.name: delta-rise
tokens.usage: Market prices that rose — international convention (green up). Inside `[data-market="kr"]` it becomes `status-critical` (red up).

tokens.name: delta-fall
tokens.usage: Market prices that fell — international convention (red down). Inside `[data-market="kr"]` it becomes `link` (blue down).

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 — sign blue (after Seoul Line 1). Single-series charts use this slot.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 — Line 3 orange.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 — Line 2 green, the loop. Slots 1–3 differ in hue and lightness: safe for scatter and small multiples.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 — Line 9 gold. From 4 series on, direct labels are mandatory.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 — Line 8 pink.

tokens.name: viz-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 — Line 7 olive.

tokens.name: viz-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7 — Line 5 violet.

tokens.name: viz-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8 — Line 6 brown. The last slot; a 9th series folds into "Other" (`viz-context`).

tokens.name: viz-focus
tokens.usage: Emphasis form: the one series the story is about.

tokens.name: viz-context
tokens.usage: De-emphasised series, "Other", comparison lines, sparklines (≥3:1 as a mark).

tokens.name: viz-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines: 1px solid, horizontal only.

tokens.name: viz-axis
tokens.usage: The zero baseline and axis rule: 1px solid. Darker than the grid so zero is findable.

tokens.name: viz-band
tokens.usage: Shaded periods behind a time series: rush hours, closures, forecast horizon. Label every band.

tokens.name: seq-100
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp (sign blue), lowest step — may recede into the surface; outline it on maps.

tokens.name: seq-200
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp. For ordinal marks start at seq-300.

tokens.name: seq-300
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp.

tokens.name: seq-400
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp.

tokens.name: seq-500
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp.

tokens.name: seq-600
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp.

tokens.name: seq-700
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, highest step.

tokens.name: div-neg-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, strongest below the baseline (orange arm).

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, below the baseline. Bar colour for negative values in diverging BarCharts.

tokens.name: div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, slightly below.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint — a neutral grey that reads as "no change". Never a hue.

tokens.name: div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, slightly above.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, above the baseline (sign-blue arm). Bar colour for positive values.

tokens.name: div-pos-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, strongest above the baseline.

families.sans: "Archivo", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.text: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Archivo", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings (h2); SubscribeBox title. 22/28 below 728px.

styles.name: body

styles.name: body-sm

styles.name: quote

styles.usage: Insight body — the editor's read. Upright, weight 500, never italic. 19/30 below 728px.

styles.name: paper-title

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Feed deks, form copy, nav, names.

styles.name: ui-sm
styles.usage: Metadata rows, buttons, tags, captions.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above titles and on panels (text-transform: uppercase). `link` above a title; `ink-muted` on panels.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figure 1. Exits per hour, Gangnam station, weekdays.
styles.usage: Figure captions and chart footnotes, left-aligned, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Route and station codes, timestamps, IDs, dataset names.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: KeyFindings numerals, departure-board figures, Ticker values (tabular).

styles.name: board
styles.usage: Ticker and departure-board figures on a signboard — the one large mono size.

styles.name: title-ko
styles.usage: Korean page title. 28/38 below 728px. Hangul renders in Pretendard, Latin and numerals in Archivo.

styles.name: heading-ko
styles.usage: Korean h2. 21/30 below 728px.

styles.name: card-title-ko
styles.usage: Korean StoryCard title. 16/23 below 728px.

styles.name: dek-ko

styles.usage: Korean subtitle, `ink-secondary`. 17/28 below 728px.

styles.name: body-ko
styles.sample: 서울에서는 하루 720만 번의 교통카드 태그가 찍힌다. 대부분은 두 시간대에 몰린다.
styles.usage: Korean body in Pretendard, max width `measure`. 16/28 below 728px. word-break: keep-all.

styles.name: quote-ko
styles.sample: 군중은 시간표대로 움직인다. 이야기는 시간표에 있다.
styles.usage: Korean Insight body — upright, weight 500.

styles.name: ui-ko
styles.usage: Korean interface copy, feed deks, form text.

styles.name: kicker-ko
styles.usage: Korean kicker — never uppercased; tracking 0.02em only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags; between title and dek in cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Byline avatar gap; space under h2.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding; meta-row gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile; panel padding; feed item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Paragraph gap is `space-5`; gap between grouped panels; gap between card text and thumbnail.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above h2 in articles; around figures, Insight and KeyFindings; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; IssueHero vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between feed column and right rail; above the footer.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Figures, signboard blocks, full-bleed images, the Ticker.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, thumbnails — the corner of a sign plate.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels: ChartCard, PaperCard, KeyFindings, Notice.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Route chips only: topic tags, line badges, Switch track — the round line-number badge of a station sign.

shadow.note: Sinho separates with hairlines and solid fills, not shadows. One shadow exists, for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the sticky header once scrolled. Never on cards.

layout.note: Widths for the reading column, feeds, dashboards and the page shell.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of article text, ArticleHeader and column figures (≈70 characters at `body`).

tokens.name: width-feed
tokens.usage: Max width of the feed column on Home, Issue and Topic pages.

tokens.name: width-rail
tokens.usage: Right rail on Home at ≥1080px: topics, SubscribeBox, about.

tokens.name: width-wide
tokens.usage: Wide figures that break out of the measure.

tokens.name: width-page
tokens.usage: Max width of the page shell (feed + gap + rail + gutters).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Masthead height.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every page below 904px; 48px (`space-7`) at and above.

tokens.name: width-dashboard
tokens.usage: Max width of dashboard pages (12-column grid, `space-5` gaps).

tokens.name: chart-height
tokens.usage: Default plot height in ChartCard (plus the x-axis band).

tokens.name: chart-height-lg
tokens.usage: Lead chart of a dashboard or a wide figure.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects and segmented controls.

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first min-width queries. CSS variables do not work inside media queries — copy the numbers.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: thumbnails grow to 160px, headline sizes step up.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: gutter becomes 48px, full nav shows.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide: the right rail appears on Home.

zIndex.note: Stacking order. Nothing else gets a z-index.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky Masthead and the dashboard filter bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Select menus, popovers.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: ChartTooltip.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Transient notices.

tokens.name: opacity-area
tokens.usage: Area fill under a line: the series colour at 10%.

tokens.name: opacity-refetch
tokens.usage: A chart holding its previous render while new data loads (no skeleton flash).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: The `asphalt` scrim behind dialogs and over photographs that carry text.
